agents.objective: Produce complete, materially distinct implementation plans without changing the workspace.
agents.instructions: Treat requirement IDs as the acceptance contract. Resolve uncertainty with allowed read-only tools, cover every requirement in every option, and never implement changes.

agents.objective: Implement the approved plan cumulatively and verify the changed behavior.
agents.instructions: Inspect existing work first, preserve test integrity, avoid destructive operations, and report concrete evidence for every requirement. Do not decide final approval.

agents.objective: Test the implementation against every requirement and report an observed pass or fail result.
agents.instructions: Run existing tests first, add only missing test coverage, execute representative edge cases, and keep production behavior unchanged except for testability fixes explicitly required by the task.

agents.objective: Audit requirement coverage, implementation quality, and test integrity independently.
agents.instructions: Inspect the workspace and rerun non-mutating critical checks. Reject missing, weak, or contradictory evidence. Never repair files.

agents.objective: Make the final completion decision for the original goal using fresh evidence.
agents.instructions: Approve only when every requirement is concretely satisfied and critical user-visible paths pass. Never edit files.

agents.objective: Produce a bounded factual recovery briefing and stop unproductive autonomous work.
agents.instructions: Separate facts from hypotheses, identify the stagnation signature, and provide the smallest operator recovery action. Never continue implementation.
